notes: Bear Form tank at 60. Primal Bite on its 6 s cooldown, Lacerate kept ticking (Rend and Tear reads it), Maul queued on the next swing, Swipe as the rage dump, Barkskin on cooldown and Frenzied Regeneration as the heal under half health. Measured in the sim's tank fight (level 63 boss, 2.0 s swing, 2400 to 3192, 180 s, healer 600 HPS) in the engine's own level 60 bear set: this order gave about 1005 threat per second against 806 for Primal Bite and Maul alone (Berserk, then in the rotation, added 4 percent; client 1.60.1.70707 removed it from the tree), Barkskin cost 1.6 percent threat for 5 percent less damage taken. Left out on purpose: Demoralizing Roar, because the fight's boss has no attack power for it to reduce (measured 1.8 percent less threat for no change in damage taken, and the raid debuff already supplies it when it is on), and Enrage, which bought 2.7 percent threat for 1.8 percent more damage taken (it takes 27 percent of base armor for 10 s), a trade a tank rotation should not make by default. Client 1.60.1.70707 made Lacerate a Feral talent (the guide build takes it) and Primal Bite the Feral capstone. The Lacerate bleed stacking, its direct hit (10% weapon damage per stack already up, live tooltip), Frenzied Regeneration's conversion and Enrage's armor penalty are not in the client tables and are the engine's stated assumptions (sim/druid/lacerate.go, enrage.go, frenzied_regeneration.go).

priorityList.notes: Barkskin on cooldown: 20% less physical damage for 15 s of every 60 (about 5% less damage taken measured against the tank fight).
Frenzied Regeneration as the emergency heal: under half health with 20 rage to convert.
Primal Bite (talent) on cooldown: the biggest threat hit per rage.

Lacerate (a Feral talent since client 1.60.1.70707) to start the bleed, to build it to five stacks, and again when under 3 s remain; the bleed is what turns on Rend and Tear, and since 70707 its hit is 10% weapon damage per stack already up, so building to five measured about 3% more threat and 2% more damage in the tank fight than refreshing at one stack.
Queue Maul on the next swing whenever 15 rage is on hand, which keeps the rest for Primal Bite and Lacerate.
Swipe is the rage dump above 40, a flat hit on up to three targets.
